features.name: targeted_personal_insult
features.value: Uses a derogatory epithet to characterize a named individual
features.rationale: The post directly attacks a specific person with a negative label rather than only discussing policy.

features.name: policy_focus_abortion_restrictions

features.rationale: The content explicitly discusses abortion bans and consequences for pregnant women.

features.name: medieval_or_barbaric_evaluative_framing

features.name: generic_group_attack

features.rationale: The text uses a derogatory generalization aimed at a category of people.

features.name: anti_nra_directive

features.rationale: It includes a direct call to action aimed at rejecting influence from NRA.
